result.reason: The revision appropriately extends the licence to Affiliates and contractors and removes discretionary revocability, but it does not reach either playbook position because it provides no transfer right for an M&A successor. It also permits revocation upon any expiration or termination allowed by Section 3, rather than making paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable and limiting termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the existing use restrictions, although “irrevocable except upon expiration or termination” is imprecise.
